text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is part of Antarctica.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
Premises:
NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutinCove, southwestCoastOfSnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
Island(snowIsland) ∧ Island(greenwichIsland) ∧ Island(deceptionIsland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
Antarctica(southShetlandIslands) ::: The South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.
LocatedIn(southShetlandIslands, antarctica) ::: The South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.
LocatedIn(a, b) ∧ LocatedIn(b, c) → LocatedIn(a, c) ::: If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C.
Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Cove(x) ∧ Antarctica(y) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y) ∧ ∃z (Settlement(z) ∧ z in Bulgaria)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
